quote: To effectively assess synthesized story premises as open-ended texts with defined semantics, we introduce five automated evaluation metrics: two for diversity and three for quality.
We introduce five automated evaluation metrics: two for diversity (breadth and density) and three for quality (fascination, completeness, originality). All scores are obtained automatically.
